name: object-aware-choreography-service
description: A service providing functionalities related to object-aware choreography.

scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node ./build/main.js
scripts.test: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node --test --import tsx $(find ./test -name '*.test.ts' -type f | sort)
scripts.test:silent: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOG_LEVEL=silent node --test --import tsx $(find ./test -name '*.test.ts' -type f | sort)
scripts.evaluation: npm run typecheck:evaluation && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node --test --import tsx $(find ./evaluation -name '*.test.ts' -type f | sort)
scripts.evaluation:silent: npm run typecheck:evaluation && cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOG_LEVEL=silent node --test --import tsx $(find ./evaluation -name '*.test.ts' -type f | sort)

author: Tom Lichtenstein
